The Great swamp became home to fish and frogs
The Mangroves drew mana from the ground and let the hatchlings drink their sap
Croakius was one of the smallest tadpoles in his school
But one sip from the Mother Tree and he wasn't a frog anymore
In the coldest part of the great swamp^ a child of the Mother Tree
a mighty Red Maple continuously burned and felled through the ages

Grandpa tends this sapling^ having it sprout and grow like flame through sheer determination^ and then to warm those loyal^ Spirit Flame burns itself away to feed the reptiles on Warm Sap to warm their cold blooded hearts

First born of Mother^ tasked with teaching the frogs
Through dreams and study it helped them grow
but the Eclipse came and dreams became nightmares
So a young girl fled to find Dreaming's Mother
Mother stood tall since before the Attuning
Her children granting blessing to those with Cold Blood
But some wanted more and began to strike down her children
So she sunk deep into the ground to mourn
Ruined was the world from the wars of greedy. And the talon plucked the glimmer of Order that remained
Dungeons shifted many times that day^ as spirals broke and formed anew. Like all things it had been reborn
Each of the claws sat atop the world basking in their victory over the common beasts of the world. The Horizon invited them forward^ and so Corvus lept first
The Sky Is that of black plumage and metal. Seeking the Songs yet written
The Sun is an untamed beast yet the holiest of all^ singing the Song to us
The Stars is the option never considered. Looking back and Singing the Forgotten Songs
I am the one who hatches first^ looking back at Nine who shaped the world
Upon hatching you will repeat the song that carved the world
This song must not cease^ as like clockwork it provides order
I am the one who hatches second and guides us to the song sung outside the egg
Upon hatching you will guide those that raised us
This song must not cease^ as like a chain it binds us together
I am the one who hatches last^ taking time to grow the strongest
Upon hatching you will hold the world with a wing of order and a talon of chaos
This song must not cease^ as like treasure it controls this world
Facing the destruction of their kingdom^ the four leaders met The Phoenix
The phoenix responded that death was a part of the cycle of the world^ and that they would be reborn
Strix accepted the fate that he had been given. It had been a good life.
Noctua rejected the notion. The Phoenix was a fraud!
Buteos fearful of his demise pleaded with phoenix^ offering the lives of his people^ his wealth^ anything to be allowed to live
Corvus sat in silence as his rage began to boil
Strix lay lifeless after he failed to stop the betrayers
Powerless^ he watched through darkening vision them strike down the Phoenix and use foul magics to be reborn
And though he sat in his egg far longer than the three

after the Dogs fled back to their Sacred Isle
Rodents came out of the wood and began to rebuild

Conscripted to the army never to be seen again
To find the center of the Dungeon
The kind King ruled justly for many years
Something that followed him back up
Whispering secrets he should have never known
His open hand became a closed fist
Long have we suffered under King
Our Friends and family forced to explore the Dungeon
To fill the coffers of some self important beast!
No more^ people of Oakshire! Today we fight back!
A Vulture circled overhead - four banners beneath it
After 30 days it descended and tore the dogs asunder
Those that remained sailed back to their Isle in a far off land
It is said it is circling around riches beyond imagining
When she saw her empire burn
She sought aid from hedgehogs of old
Plucked their quills^ she dulled claw in turn
And that's how cats came to the fold
She plucks a quill and heals the sick
Revives the hurt with just a prick
She finds one more and teaches her
We help all beast despite their fur
